title: Which Islands Can You See From Madeira, and When?
description: On clear days you see the Desertas, 30 to 40 km south-east of Funchal. Porto Santo shows only from high or eastern points. The Selvagens are never visible.
heroAlt: The long, low Desertas Islands on the south-eastern horizon, seen from a boat off Funchal
keywords: which islands can you see from Madeira
can you see the Desertas from Funchal
can you see Porto Santo from Madeira

images.prompt: Late afternoon in January, about an hour before sunset, seen from the bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, a short way off Funchal, Madeira, looking south-east across open water. On the horizon, the long low chain of the Desertas Islands: a flat table-like islet at the left, a long high island in the middle, a thinner one at the right, their western cliffs lit warm by the low sun. Very clear air, deep blue calm sea, a pale blue sky. Only the white bow rail and a coiled rope in the foreground, no people, true colours, no text.
images.alt: The long, low Desertas Islands on the south-eastern horizon, seen from a boat off Funchal

images.prompt: Early morning from the Pico do Arieiro viewpoint in Madeira: a sea of white clouds below the rocky ridges, and far off on the north-eastern horizon above the clouds the faint grey outline of Porto Santo island, one walker seen small from behind at the railing, clear sky, realistic photo, no text.
images.alt: Porto Santo faint on the horizon above a sea of clouds, seen from Pico do Arieiro
